title: Lebanon Death Toll Since March 2 Crosses 3,000 as Israeli Strikes Kill 5 More
detail: Lebanon's Ministry of Public Health officially reported that the cumulative death toll from Israeli military operations since March 2, 2026 had crossed 3,000 — a grim milestone in a conflict that began with Israel's renewed offensive following the expiry of diplomatic ultimatums. At least 5 people were killed in fresh Israeli air attacks across southern and eastern Lebanon on May 18 alone. The 3,000 figure does not separate combatant and civilian casualties, as Lebanon's health ministry records all killed in Israeli strikes. Hezbollah does not publish its own fighter casualty figures. The IOM meanwhile reported that over 596 collective displacement sites remained active across Lebanon, sheltering 128,200+ internally displaced persons, with 87% of the over 1 million displaced living outside organised shelters in the homes of friends, relatives, or in informal settings.

media.caption: IOM reports 1 million displaced as Lebanon death toll from Israeli strikes crosses 3,000

title: EU Humanitarian Air Bridge Delivers 4,500+ Emergency Shelter Items to Beirut
detail: More than 4,500 emergency shelter and household items were airlifted from Maastricht, Netherlands to Beirut's Rafic Hariri International Airport via an EU Humanitarian Air Bridge, reflecting the scale of humanitarian need from Lebanon's ongoing displacement crisis. The airlift came amid continued Israeli military operations that were preventing large-scale aid delivery by road to many areas of south Lebanon. UN OCHA's flash appeal for Lebanon for March–May 2026 remained underfunded relative to the estimated need. More than 596 collective displacement sites remained active across the country, while international NGOs reported acute shortages of basic medical supplies, food, and water in conflict-affected southern villages.

media.caption: EU humanitarian air bridge delivers emergency shelter items to Beirut as 1 million Lebanese remain displaced
